acceptanceCriteria: each of newContext, routeWebSocket and routeFromHAR is recorded or explicitly refused with a vector
the producer-absent case emits an explicit NOT_PRODUCED reason without changing legacy receipt bytes, or the spec records why omission is sufficient
the external-profile revision is decided by the owner and recorded
body: Residual from the V1-1458 lane (PR #957, 2026-10-16). Not covered: (1) routes registered on contexts created with browser.newContext() (only the fixture page/context are wrapped); (2) page.routeWebSocket; (3) routeFromHAR is not separately qualified; (4) when no attempt in a receipt has a corvint-route-stubs record (producer not installed) the routeStubs member is omitted to keep legacy bytes identical, which the spec defines as NOT_PRODUCED, but no per-test explicit reason is emitted. Owner decision bundled here: carrying the record on the /0-/3 external receipt profiles needs a new profile revision. Control-path stubs (#872) stay out of scope.
title: test-validity route stubs: record browser.newContext() contexts, routeWebSocket and routeFromHAR, and give an explicit NOT_PRODUCED reason when no attempt carries a record
